The '''Ramorea system''' was located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] known as [[Ramorean capanata]].<ref name="Jabba">{{StoryCite|story=Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Ramorean capanata]]|system=Ramorea [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ramorea [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-7.<ref name="TEA" />
